pages.text: The jewel. I'd forgotten how it catches the light.$(br2)The next piece is inside the Wither. Three skulls and four blocks of soul sand. I never had the nerve to build one. If you do, do it far from home.
$(o)Nobody whispers about this one. Nobody's fool enough to build it. The Crest of the Crown is inside the Wither, wherever you dare to raise it.$()
